skill.displayName: Brat Generator – Free Brat Meme & Album Cover Generator Inspired by Charli XCX – API-powered
skill.summary: AI brat generator — create a Charli XCX brat-style album cover meme with custom text and color

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the brat-generator-openapi-skill v1.0.0
- Generate Charli XCX brat-style album cover memes with customizable text and color.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Provides endpoints for starting a meme generation run, polling status, and uploading images.
- Includes detailed API usage instructions, security guidance, and field descriptions.
